title: Brookdale to Present at the 2026 Stephens Annual Investment Conference | NASH2026
summary: Brookdale Senior Living Inc. (NYSE: BKD) ("Brookdale" or "the Company") announced today that Company management is scheduled to participate in the upcoming Stephens Annual Investment Conference | NASH2026, to be held in Nashville, Tennessee. On November 19, 2026, Company management will participate in a fireside chat that will begin at 11:45 am CST (12:45 pm EST), and the live webcast and a replay will be available at brookdaleinvestors.com.
